title: Children shifting random number generators with thought
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: technological a random number generator, there are examples where I personally and watched other kids push them sigas sigas of multitudes and held for hours just by using our thoughts.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that as a child, around 2008 to 2010, he took part in tests at Baker Victory Services, a children's services organisation in Western New York, which he links to a government UFO program. He says that he and other children were able to push a random number generator, a machine that spits out unpredictable numbers, far off its normal pattern and hold it there for hours using only their thoughts. If true, it would mean children's minds can directly affect machines, and that someone was studying this.
